headline: B3 and Major Brazilian Banks Launch Blockchain Stablecoin Open BRL
summary: Exchange operator B3 and six of Brazil's largest banks announced the creation of Open BRL, a stablecoin pegged to the Brazilian real to explore tokenized financial assets on a shared blockchain infrastructure.
why: The entry of traditional financial market infrastructures and major banks into stablecoin technology bridges decentralized finance with regulated banking systems.

impacts.name: B3 SA Brasil Bolsa Balcao
impacts.why: Participation in tokenized asset infrastructure expands B3's digital asset product offerings.
